pullRequests.title: docs: short README and docs sorted into folders
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: docs/readme-cleanup
pullRequests.body:
Before
A 131-line README with long setup steps, and docs in one flat folder with mixed-case names.
After
A short README like Lombyte's: the OpenRAC logo with "decompilation project" under it, a code badge for each version, progress, quick setup, credits and license (96 lines). The details moved to docs/, now sorted into docs/build, docs/contributing, docs/game, docs/agents and docs/history (with the old notes/ folder), with lowercase names and a docs/README.md index.
How
Files moved with git…
